active_continuity: The Dark Heaven assault has crossed from the Outer Hall into the Inner Hall; nearly one hundred Tang Clan members, including Tang Jinhu, are dead, and the attack remains in progress.
The Western Heaven Demon Lord has defeated Tang Sadok's last counterattack, captured him, and is demanding the location of the Myriad-Poison Ring.
Only two members of the Tang Clan's former Ten Wonders remain alive after the Western Heaven Demon Lord kills one of the three survivors.
First Fiend has been ordered to fight Cheongpung and may kill him if he cannot be subdued; Cheongpung is actively resisting him.
The Western Heaven Demon Lord and the Blood Lord serve the same master, and the Blood Lord wants to personally kill Cheongpung, Jeok Cheongang, and Jin Taekyung.
Jeok Cheongang and Jin Taekyung are being treated at the Tang Clan, and the Western Heaven Demon Lord intends to take them and Cheongpung alive if possible.
The Uninvited Guest Quest remains accepted with unknown parameters and death as its failure condition.
open_questions: Can the Sichuan Tang Clan survive the assault?
Can Cheongpung survive First Fiend and change the battle's outcome?
Where is the Myriad-Poison Ring, and can it be secured before the Tang Clan falls?
What are the limits and nature of the Western Heaven Demon Lord's demonic martial art?
Will Jeok Cheongang recover before the siege exposes him to capture or further harm?
temporary_decisions: Render 일괴, 이괴, and 삼괴 as First Fiend, Second Fiend, and Third Fiend.
Render 악귀 as Fiend when used for the First Fiend's descriptive epithet.
Render 마군 as Demon Lord when used for the Western Heaven Demon Lord's shortened title.
Render 초대받지 않은 손님 as Uninvited Guest.
